create_arize_phoenix_logger: create an ArizePhoenixLogger instance that sends OpenTelemetry traces to a Phoenix endpoint
get_arize_phoenix_config: get Arize Phoenix configuration from environment variables including endpoint, protocol, and API key
set_arize_phoenix_attributes: set OpenTelemetry span attributes with Arize Phoenix metadata and dynamic project name from request metadata
get_dynamic_project_name: retrieve dynamic Phoenix project name from request metadata for routing traces to different projects
test_arize_phoenix_health: test Arize Phoenix health by verifying PHOENIX_API_KEY environment variable is configured
